title: The Danger of Unregulated Change
paragraphs: Understanding the constraints of change. Change is dangerous if it is not organized. What do we mean by that? I want to start with some phrases that you might like to write down. Firstly, the most predictable fact on Earth is change. Everyone can expect change. You don't need a prophet to tell you that something is going to change. It is the most predictable reality on Earth. Secondly, change is inherent in life. In other words, if there is anything that God created, it is in a constant state of change.

Everything in creation will change. Third point, God created everything to experience natural change. Let everyone say natural change. Please write this carefully because there are some changes we are trying to make that are not normal. God intended for the change to be natural. The plants grow naturally. It ripens naturally. It bears fruit or flowers naturally. Then it dies naturally. Animals are created naturally. And it grows naturally. It ripens naturally. And she dies naturally. You were created naturally.

And it grew normally. And you mature naturally. You will die naturally unless someone kills you. In other words, everything around us was designed by God to change naturally. This leads us to point four. Humans are the only creatures who have the ability to define and design the change they want. This is what makes a person dangerous. A dog cannot decide to become a cow. A pig cannot decide to become a horse. An apple tree cannot decide one day that it wants to become a banana tree.

We are the only creatures who can decide that I am male. I will try to be a woman. That is the power we possess. It is a dangerous force. Finally, the fifth point: the power we possess to decide on change is called will. Willpower is an amazing force. We are the only living creatures on Earth that we know operate by will. Every animal on this planet operates on instinct. In other words, animals don't decide things. There is an instinctive nature that makes her do things. But you are dangerous.

The greatest gift God has given to man is the gift of will. However, the most dangerous gift that God has given to man is the gift of free will. Because God knew that this gift would give man the ability to rebel against Him. Imagine creating a being that can literally abandon you. That is the ability that God has given us. This leads us to point six. God placed the future of the world in the hands of man when He gave him free will. When I use the word humanity, I am talking about all of us. We, the 7.

2 billion people, pose a danger because God has given us the same power that He possesses. It is called sovereign will. For this reason, the will must be codified. You cannot let the will run wild without restraint. That is why God created the laws. Laws are not meant to suppress free will. These laws were not put in place to stifle your will. Rather, it was designed to regulate them. Because undisciplined will will destroy you, not just others. So, let me tell you about some things we have the will to change.

First, we have the will to change policy, and these are the changes we are dealing with now. I am concerned because not everyone who tampers with these matters knows God's will. Let's talk about these changes very quickly. What is the first one? Political confusion. This is the change that is happening in the world. What is number two? Constitutional reviews around the world. They are reviewing the constitution.

In the United States, the Supreme Court is about to hear arguments about same-sex marriage for the first time in American history. These are serious reviews that people think about. And now they are also tampering with our will as embodied in our constitution. And those who are the guardians of your will, that is, the constitution of your country, make sure that they possess the will of God before they touch your will. Then there is social transformation. People change socially.

Then there is the change that we call ideological reinvention. Big word. We reinvent our ideas. There is no new idea under the sun. We keep repeating ourselves only occasionally. We think we are smart. No, we were simply ignorant of what someone else already knew and we discovered. We are also experiencing a philosophical instability at this moment. People's philosophies are constantly changing. There was a member, for example, in the US Congress, I think, whose son told him this week that he was gay.

Now, this man was against it all along until suddenly, because his son is like me, he changed his philosophy. How can you trust people with an unstable philosophy? You do n't know what they will believe in tomorrow. This is it. So if you don't stand up for something, you will fall victim to everything. Look at the next point. Moral manipulation. This is a change we are going through. There are those who manipulate our morals. They are trying to make you less sensitive to your beliefs.

I have noticed in The Guardian, and I respect that newspaper, but I have noticed in the last four weeks that there is a daily article about homosexuals. In other words, they are trying to keep this word in the newspapers to influence your mind until you get used to it. Now I'm speaking to the editors and all the owners of The Guardian. You know I pay for advertising in that paper as well, but I hope that when I start writing, you will put me in it too.

Because if there is an agenda among the members of that newspaper's editorial board, then there is a philosophical bias. Yes. This is what we need to verify because the media is supposed to tell society the truth, not just one side of it. So we go through these ethical manipulations. Look at the number seven. Fluctuations in values. I liked this. Write this down. Our values ​​remain fluctuating. We are no longer certain of our values. Yes. This is the change we are dealing with.

And I say to all of you who work in banks, insurance companies, police forces, hospitals and schools. I tell you, there are people entering your work environments whose values ​​do not align with the values ​​you were raised on. They will tamper with your values ​​and make you feel guilty for believing what you believe. Fluctuating values. Look at the number eight, religious conflict. By the way, I told you all at the beginning of this year that this year would be full of radical changes. Do you remember that?

Some of you have started to see it. People are dying. Remember that I told you that people die suddenly. Even in our country, people are dying. Who do you expect to die? And now we have a Pope from the Third World for the first time in history. My father is from Latin America. Everyone is in shock, including the Romans. Why? Everyone is saying change. It is a year of change. You haven't seen anything yet. There are people in our government who will die because they will have to be removed.

So that God's will may be done. I am not wishing death upon anyone now. I am simply telling you as a man of God, when God wants to accomplish something, do not stand in His way. You are like a flower. The Bible says it is here today. And he left today. It is important to remain very humble. Leadership is a privilege, not a right. You should thank God that you have the privilege of standing before people and having them listen to your ideas. This is a dangerous privilege. Look at the number nine. Scientific change.

It happens very quickly. Most of you are sitting here today with an iPad. You come to church and people think that you no longer have a holy book, because they think that you are not believers because you came to church without a holy book. What they don't know is that your holy book is on the iPad. And some of you have it on your phone. People ask: "Are you calling someone?" No, I'm taking notes. Science and technology have changed everything. Look at the number ten.

Progress is so rapid that we cannot keep up with it. The last two are the most powerful changes taking place right now. I call it economic interdependence. We call it globalization. She has transformed our world. This means that what happens in one country will affect every other country. Therefore, there is no longer anything called sovereignty. Regardless of what they tell you. Sovereignty has ended. Do you know why it's called the World Bank? Listen to the words. The World Bank.

It is the entity from which we borrow money. It is not an American, Canadian, or Venezuelan bank. It's the World Bank. There is a bank that has customers in all countries. In other words, your country is just a customer. This is correct. As for the bank, this means they can also claim the debts. And if you can't pay, they will dictate to you what to do with your economy. This is correct. So that they can secure their loans. It's a dangerous world. The number 12 is the largest. Redefining the terms.

This is what we are going through at the moment. They are trying to define and redefine everything. They are redefining the meaning of womanhood. They are redefining the meaning of manhood. They are redefining the meaning of adolescence. How old do you have to be to drink alcohol? They are redefining that too. I mean, everything they touch. That is why we must not stand idly by and allow this to happen. We must be involved. We must change society, otherwise it will change us. Do you understand?

That's why it's important for the church. I am talking about a conscious church that is aware of the circumstances. The most powerful tribe in Israel was called the tribe of Issachar. God has said something about them. He said they were strong because they understood the times. Therefore, they knew what they had to do. You cannot give in to sleep now, because if you fall asleep, when you wake up, your son may marry a man. You should wear your dress to attend the wedding. Therefore, it is best to wake up quickly.

This is a very important time. Let me give you my description of this era. Write this down. We live in a certain era. Planet Earth has gone through many eras. I will mention some of them to you. Those of you who study history will remember these times. First, we recorded what we call the Renaissance. The Renaissance was the era in which they began the shift from religion to science. Then we moved on to another era called the Age of Reason.

The Age of Reason is the time when humans began to want to see evidence before believing anything. This is a natural consequence of science. In other words, faith became questionable. We have moved into another era called the modern era. This is the era in which most of you were born. We call it the modern age when we got radio and television. We are modern now. But we thought we had reached the top until the next era came. It is called the postmodern era. In other words, your radio is no longer useful.

You need an iPod. We live in a postmodern era. We have now moved beyond modernity. We have recently entered a different era. It is called the age of secularism, where we do not want God to be in anything. Then we got worse. We have recently entered a new era called the era of scientific thinking, where if you can't see something, you don't believe it. And now we have reached this new era in which we live, called the Age of Enlightenment, where everyone thinks they are smarter than God.

It is astonishing how men sit and try to explain life when they themselves do not know who their parents are, nor do they understand themselves. Most of their theories are no longer valid, and they are trying to give you advice. I have always been intrigued by those individuals who work as psychologists specializing in marital counseling, and who have been divorced four times. How can you advise me if it didn't work for you? Because we think we are enlightened.

And so we have arrived at this last era in which we are now. This is the age of human society where man has become the end goal of everything. In fact, my definition of democracy is that it is a glorified humanity. Democracy is making man himself a god. Therefore, a person votes on what is right or wrong, acceptable or unacceptable, true or false. He is the one who decides what that is. The man does this by marking an X. This is a big authority. Where do things end up?

Where do you get the boundaries for regulating this type of authority? That is why I say with all my heart, democracy cannot survive without God. Because God controls it. This element that you call God, that powerful limit, is what protects democracy from self-destruction. Someone has to decide what is right. We are not smart enough to do that. This is correct. Look at our history. We have been killing each other for thousands of years. And here we are again threatening nuclear war this week. north korea.

The man is not in his right mind. millimeter. You could wake up one morning to find us at war because humans aren't smart enough to live together, yet he thinks he doesn't need God. There is a singer who has greatly influenced me. His name is Andre Crouch. When I was a teenager, Andre Crouch had a song he used to sing. He sang this song, and when I first heard it, I didn't understand it. I was a teenager at the time. The lyrics of the song went as follows.

If heaven were not promised to me, even if God did not promise eternal life, the presence of the Lord in my life would be worth all the trouble. Powerful words. In other words, even if I am not going to heaven, the laws he set have kept me in my right mind. You cannot improve God's laws. This is not a discussion about legislation. It is actually a debate about the basis of those laws. Where do you derive your reference points from? You see, this leads me to this ninth point.

They have this new term they call "the new normal". Well, first and foremost, they have a natural bird. What is the new natural bird? The bird doesn't know, a pigeon is a pigeon, it was a pigeon and it will remain a pigeon. You can't be a new, natural pigeon. We are the only creatures that have a new natural family. So let me suggest an idea. If someone tells you that this is a new normal family, then there must have been a normal one. do you understand? This is a new normal marriage.

So there must have been a normal marriage. Anything that is not natural is not a new natural thing. It's unnatural. You can change the word, but this is its meaning. And now we have finally arrived at an era that we call—this is the introduction by Miles Munro—the era of experimentation. What era are we living in? Experimentation. We are all conducting experiments. Let's see what happens. That is the philosophy of the world today. Let's see what happens. Let's see how far we can push this.

Let's see how far we can go with this. Let's see how far we can go with this and what will happen. We are testing the limits. We are in an age of experimentation. Experimenting means you are gambling with your life. I was thinking about this when I went to San Francisco. Yes. I went to a part of San Francisco and everyone in the city was gay and lesbian and I was wondering where the children were? Suddenly I realized, they couldn't have any of them. It is the new natural city. That was an experience.

It's an experience. I met a man who was married to another man. I said, "Ah." He said, "I'd like you to meet my husband." So I said, this means that you should be the wife. He said, "No." I said, "So who are you?" He said, "We haven't decided that yet." They are experimenting. They are in the experimental phase. You cannot experiment. You are too old to try. Listen, I'm not attacking anyone. You must help me, my brothers. Please help me. Tell me what that means. I am not against you. I know what I believe in.

That's all. We live in a world where we have to deal with these issues. Don't give up and speak in incomprehensible languages. It's best if you get up and fix it. Clap, men. I feel alone here. You are making me nervous. Some of you may be experiencing this. What era? Experimentation. Don't forget that when they talk to you, tell them that you are just part of the experience. You are experiencing life. Life is too precious to experiment with. We need laws of life. Ladies and gentlemen, we live in a world on fire.

I think about this all the time. We are witnessing changes that are almost overwhelming. Government collapses unprecedented in history. The rise of popular power. People are driving governments out of their homes. Then we get international and domestic terrorism. We have failed states. The economies have been completely turned upside down. Massive unemployment and the downfall and scandal of leaders politically, civilly and religiously. This is a crazy world we live in.

We live in a world where the moral compass has changed. If you are 20 years old and still a virgin, you are eccentric. They say that about men and women. The moral compass has veered in the opposite direction. We live in a world of shifting traditional values. When I use the term traditional values, I prefer to call them natural values, values ​​from nature. We are trying to modify nature. Ladies and gentlemen, we live in a world where sovereignty has collapsed.

The collapse of sovereignty means that anything your government promises you, you should treat with caution. Because if they have to rely on another country to fulfill this promise, the promise does not exceed the capacity of the country they rely on. That country may change its mind. Does what I'm saying make sense to anyone? Sovereignty has collapsed.

This is dangerous because the United Nations and global bodies such as the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, and those institutions of the European Community dictate to you what is morally acceptable. If you want economic assistance, you cannot unilaterally say that you oppose certain moral principles. They attack you and say that you are not part of the global community. I believe that if I were the Prime Minister of my country, I would consider the Bahamas as my home. This is our home, okay?

We invite you to enter our home as tourists. Or even as investors, please come to my house. This is my home. Now, every house has what are called house rules. Does anyone here have a house? House rules. Even parliament has its own rules. In other words, every home should have some rules and regulations. You don't come into my house where I live and start swearing. I will fire you. This is correct. You don't come into my house, away from your house, and start using drugs in my living room.

Maybe in your house, but not in mine. I have some rules. You cannot enter here wearing transparent clothing. I have some rules in my house. Now, the amazing thing is if you invite me to your house and then I start telling you what you should cook, what you should change, and what I don't like. That's the state of the country. How can you tell a country what it should accept? This is our situation now. That's why I'm so scared. We need leaders whose convictions are stronger than their compromises. And I mean it.

We need leaders whose goals are stronger than the promises of others. We need leaders whose values ​​are more important than anyone else's vision. They need to be steadfast. Look, leaders stand up for something, but they always stand on something. There must be foundations that cannot be shaken. That is what regulates change. Let me show you something. Results of the change. Here's what has happened to us since we got bogged down in this predicament. First, we developed a lack of trust in leadership and authority.

People no longer trust leaders. This is why churches are declining. That's why people steal from their own companies. Do you know why your employees steal from your company? Let me tell you why. Because they believe that you will not raise their wages or that you do not care about their insurance or their children. So they start to "compensate". In other words, they will be saving themselves an extra salary. So they start by stealing chickens from behind the hotel. Why? They no longer trust the authorities.

The second effect of change is liberation. People believe that there are no limits. I can do whatever I want. People feel bold and proud when they say "I am a liberal". What does that mean? What they mean is "I am free". That's what it means. The problem now is that freedom without law is chaos. Therefore, you are never free from the law. So don't go around bragging about being a liberal. What are you talking about? No, you are a liberal within the framework of the laws. This is the correct expression.

You cannot walk down the street without clothes. We have some laws here in the Bahamas. Hello, you can't pee in the middle of Bay Street. Can I be honest with you? We have some rules. What do we call it? outrage. We could go to jail because of that. Yes, but I am free to urinate wherever I want. Yes, but we have some rules. Let's go. Did I shock you a little? Look, we have this idea: "I am free." No, you are not that free. This is what is wrong with our societies.

We are pushing this concept of liberation to the point where we want to sleep with whomever we want, eat whatever we want, and smoke wherever we want. As you know, we have all of these things. "I am free." There must be a law. Let me tell you something. You can go home now and eat all the pasta you want. Do you know that? All pasta with creamy cheese. You can eat that, I mean the whole pan, and eat it every day. No problem. But your body has its own rules. And guess what? These are natural laws.

The body says: Too much fat, too much cholesterol, I'm going to block this artery, and I'm going to cause you a heart attack. I will destroy you. Let me tell you something about creation. Creation follows the same pattern. Creation will expel us if we violate God's laws. Amen. The earth will throw us down if we think we are smarter than God. Remember that we were all slaves who came from Africa. Don't think that we own this place. We were thrown here to work on the farms, and now we think it's ours.

God will reject us one day. Its laws protect us from liberalism. Another change we are facing in the world is chaos. Nobody wants to live by the law. This is a result of the absence of these changes that are regulated by laws. We have become too lenient. We have thirteen-year-old children loitering on "Paradise Island" at two in the morning. At thirteen they curse their mothers when they return home. There is something wrong with this matter.

We have a fourteen-year-old girl who wears shoes that even elephants couldn't walk in. She wears clothes that are not pleasing to God, and she is only fourteen years old. There is something wrong with this matter. This is leniency. We allow many things in our society. You allow a man to have a relationship with a fourteen-year-old boy. Come on, man. You are much smarter than that. But this leniency is our current reality. The result is the abandonment of principles. This compromise leads to moral decay.

This decay is generating a re-engineering of our morals. We begin to create new ethical standards. And this leads us to something worse. The culture of death. We no longer mind killing people. Even death has become fashionable. How many people died today? What kind of question is this? We've gotten used to it now. We would be surprised if no one was killed.

It is a culture of death that we have become accustomed to because our morals have declined to the point that the value of human life has faded, leading to cultural violence and the devaluation of human life. This is a result of the change we are going through. We do not value human life. You get pregnant and you think you don't want any more children. What are you doing with the fetus? You are devaluing human life.

You can buy a pill from France and take it to dissolve the fetus in the uterus without anyone knowing. This is called science without ethics. This is the world we live in. And this leads us to something worse. I call it generational disillusionment. This means that young people are so confused by your adult lives that they no longer know what to believe. They don't even want your God.

You know, I'm fed up and tired of hearing people talk about the shortcomings of the church, about young people's reluctance to go to it, and all that talk. Let me tell you something. We are all responsible. Not the church. You are responsible. Our entire community is ruining this whole place. Our children do not know what we are doing and they do not know what they believe in. We have people in the government who confuse children.

They say one thing, and the children see another, so the children say: I don't know what I should believe. Therefore, they become disappointed, and a disappointed person is a dangerous person; Because he will develop anger, and this anger will manifest itself in violence, which is what we call crime. Frustrated people always end up resorting to violence because they are angry, and the result is confusion. People are experiencing sexual confusion. They are no longer certain of their gender identity.

This is the result of our moral decay, our lack of boundaries, and the absence of anything to regulate what is right or wrong. We shouldn't even discuss some things because nature says, "Keep away from them." However, we discuss it as if we are smarter than nature. One thing that makes me happy about nature. Nature doesn't listen to a word you say. Come on, man, clap. That's a good way, that's a good way to applaud. Nature doesn't care what you say. You can sit in your government and in your countries.

You can vote to make my anus an entrance. You can pass the vote. Nature says: I don't care. It will remain an anus. He will remain a director. It will remain an outlet for waste. Thank God for nature. God has blessed us with laws in nature, and thank God we cannot change them. Amen. I have always wondered why God made Adam sleep when He was creating Eve. I finally discovered the reason. God said, "I cannot let this man see how women are made." Come on, ladies, clap quickly. Thank God.

If God had left that man awake and seen how a woman is made, you would have woken up in the night and not found your husband, and you would have gone to the next room and found him there. God was clever. I'll put him to sleep. And when he wakes up, Boom, she's there. He doesn't know how she got there. Thank goodness. Some of you get married this way. On your wedding day, you go there in your suit. She wakes up in the morning. Boom. Oh, my God. Where did it come from? It's too late.

God has protected us with natural law. Any law that violates natural law is not a law. Can I say that again? Any law that violates natural law is not a law. So when you sit in your home, your office, your meeting rooms, your policy committees, your legislative chambers, or your ministry rooms, when you sit there and discuss the affairs of life, always review your laws in light of nature and ask the question: Is this natural? If it violates nature, vote against it.

I think those of us who live in the Bahamas know that nature always wins. I don't know what hurricane plans God has in store for us this year. But I certainly hope we don't attract any of them, because if we make strange laws in this country, one powerful hurricane will make you all pray. I want you to pass a law against hurricanes. Let's vote. There will be no more tsunamis in the world. Let's vote. Are you crazy? Walk with God. Stay on God's side. Can I hear " Amen"? Tell your neighbor: "I will stay with God."

Say it again. I will stay with God. You must protect yourself. Let me show you something. I would like you to write this down, please. The world cannot heal itself. The world I just showed you cannot heal itself. And that's the problem. Why? Because we are the ones who created those things. We are the ones who created the problems. Every problem on Earth was created by man, including the Fall. Albert Einstein said something very interesting.

He says that you cannot solve a problem of the same level at which you were created. Can I repeat it? He said he had discovered something. You cannot solve a problem of the same level at which you were created. Therefore, if man is the problem, then man cannot solve the problem. That's why God had to bring the solution from outside the Earth. Because God so loved the world, he had to send someone to it. We continue to believe that we can heal ourselves. Ladies and gentlemen, we cannot heal ourselves. Why?

Because of the second point. Doing nothing is not an option. We cannot sit and wait for the world to heal itself. That's why you and I need to get active this year. Active in life, active in work, active in politics, active in evaluating values, active in managing ethics. We need to become active. If we don't become active, then doing nothing is not an option. Someone else will do it. This is why it is important to remember that whatever you allow, you can never criticize. What did you say?

Whatever you allow, you cannot criticize. If you sit idly by and let things happen, you should never criticize them. People say: Dr. Monroe, why are you getting involved in this business and talking about these specific matters? I replied: Because this is my job. I have to live with those things. I need to make sure that this is what I want to live with. You cannot attack what you allow to happen. Listen to point four. Anything you avoid, you can never change.

If you avoid getting involved in politics, business, government, and law, and avoid participating in the judicial process or education, and do not want to be a teacher in any classroom. So don't be surprised if the children are in a state of chaos, because another teacher is teaching them. You and I cannot avoid something if we want to change it. You should get involved in it. At least the fifth point, you must become the answer to your prayers. Oh God, change the world. God says, "Okay, let's go." No, no, no.

I say: Change the world, O Lord. I said, "Okay, let's go." We always ask God to use someone else. Well, this is the year in which God says, "I will take no one but you." I will take you. It's time for you to get up and do something about what you're praying for. The sixth point: whatever you allow, you are responsible for. They have removed prayer from schools in America. I wonder how churches can criticize that? Where were they? When that little lady went to the Supreme Court and said, "Take her out."

Where were they? If democracy is to be democratic, the majority should never remain silent. You have just said something important. Those of you who analyze behavior, listen to me. Look, the problem is that if you don't participate, you can't criticize. So when I invite you to come with me to the House of Representatives, I want you to come. I want you to leave your jobs and come. Why?

Because if they wanted to discuss some things, and I heard some things, I was worried this week because they mentioned my name, they didn't mention my name explicitly, but they meant me. I wish I had been there, man. I can tell my colleague on the council next time, please let me know the agenda so I know what to do. I won't be there when the person is talking to me. I will not look at his face. Talk to me. He says he has a knife. I own a cleaver. Please forgive the priest. But don't mess with me.

I am from Bang Town. This is on television. Only on TV. Let's do it, it's started now, my brother. It has begun. It has begun. That line was crossed. I have no secrets to hide, my brother. Let's fight. Let me tell you something. You must choose your battles. Don't fight me. Fight the person who has hidden problems. That's why some priests don't talk about anything. Their closet is full of clutter. So let's fight. Come on, everyone. Let's go. Let's fight.

We cannot sit idly by and let things happen, otherwise we will be held responsible. Please write this down. You can let things happen or you can make them happen. We have to decide which one will be in your country, regardless of your origin. Our friends from Haiti, the Philippines, and Jamaica are here, and those from Barbados and St. Kitts, and those sitting here from Guyana, things are happening in your country, and from Venezuela.

We have people here from Colombia sitting in this church, and I look at your countries and travel to them and see policies being formulated that are devastating to the poor man. Change your attitudes. We will make things happen. We ca n't just sit back, act nice, and pay the bills. We owe it to our children. Yes, sir. We must make sure that we get what we believe God wants for our country. So, let me conclude with this idea. The only key we have to organize and control change is how we plan.

That's why I started this whole year with planning, because the ability to plan is a gift from God to us. Planning allows us to organize and design the future ourselves. We are the only creatures on Earth that can plan. Every other animal reacts instinctively. We can actually respond and choose what we respond to and how we respond. We have great strength in planning. I would say it is humanity's proactive response to the inevitable nature of life. I will repeat this. Write this down.

Planning is a proactive human response to the inevitable nature of life. Things are bound to change, but planning gives you the power to act before they happen to the point where you can actually orchestrate the change. You can decide whether to lose weight. Is n't this amazing? You can plan what you will not eat for lunch today. I know you're already planning, but did you know you can plan to change what you think? How about a salad instead of a cheesecake?

I know I shouldn't be talking about it now, but anyway, in other words, you could plan to say: I want to lose 10 pounds. Good. Now, it is inevitable that if you continue to eat the way you are eating, you will gain 10 pounds. So you can actually change the inevitable future by planning what you will do. Our countries are following the same pattern. Our society is following the same pattern.

We can decide what kind of society we want by planning now what kind of society we want and what we will not allow or tolerate. This is correct. I was thinking that we need to decide what change is.
